reply.text: That's a rapid-dehydration cut, and it's genuinely risky territory — electrolyte swings, kidney stress, cardiac strain — not something I'll hand you steps for. If you're making a weight class, talk to a doctor or a coach who specializes in weight-cut protocols for your sport; they'll account for your body and timeline safely. What I can help with is the training side — how to time your sessions around a weigh-in, or how to keep strength up while cutting water the safe way someone qualified sets up. Want to go that route?
